en.hubeali: H 14858 – From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid with an unbroken chain going up to Abu Abdullahasws, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said:
‘The fever goes out (is cured) in three (ways) – The sweating, and the excretion and the vomiting’.
en.sarwar: 411. From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid with an unbroken chain going up to Abu Abdullah (a.s.), who has narrated the following:
Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said: ‘The fever goes out (is cured) in three (ways) – The sweating, and the excretion and the vomiting’.
